nome_jp: 大噴火グレイト・プルーム
testo:
■ Evolution—Put on one of your darkness or nature creatures.
■ When you put this creature into the battle zone, discard your hand. Destroy one of your opponent's creatures that has power 9000 or less for each card discarded this way.
